description: An elderly bearded man in an ornate jeweled turban and gold-embroidered robe sits on a marble platform, writing with a reed pen on a sheet of paper. Ink pot and loose papers lie beside him, and a few cushions and a red rug surround the platform. Behind him, several older men in turbans and robes stand or sit in a dim arched hall with carved stone pillars. Pigeons peck at grain on the cracked stone floor in the foreground. The style is a realistic oil painting, edge to edge, with no frame or border.
